Company Description

Continental is a leading tire manufacturer and industry specialist. Founded in 1871, the company generated sales of €19.7 billion in 2025 and currently employs around 78,000 people in 54 countries and markets.

ContiTech is one of the world’s leading material experts for industry applications. The Continental group sector offers its customers reliable, safe and convenient industry and service solutions using a range of materials for off-highway applications, on rails and roads, in the air, under and above the ground, in industrial environments, for the food sector and the furniture industry. With about 20,000 employees (Status as of March 2026) at more than 60 sites globally, and sales of some 6.0 billion euros (2025), the global industrial partner is active with core branches in Asia, Europe and North and South America.

Job Description

We're looking for a motivated Antitrust Compliance Specialist (m/f/diverse) who is passionate about antitrust compliance and eager to contribute to global initiatives, foster knowledge sharing, and support the ongoing development of our compliance framework.

Your tasks will include the following activities:

- Taking an active role in enhancing and continuously improving ContiTech’s compliance program, particularly with respect to antitrust compliance
- Identifying opportunities to further strengthen the antitrust compliance program through active collaboration and communication with the regions
- Enhancing the concept for association activities and serving as the point of contact for related inquiries from all stakeholders
- Further developing the global antitrust risk assessment process and acting as the point of contact for antitrust-related questions
- Drafting, reviewing, and updating group policies and guidelines related to antitrust compliance
- Managing the rollout of global antitrust initiatives
- Developing content for antitrust training and other preventive measures in close collaboration with relevant departments
- Delivering antitrust training to all ContiTech business areas and central functions
- Designing and implementing additional mitigation measures, such as internal controls and monitoring activities
- Leading lessons-learned projects and driving ongoing improvements to the effectiveness of the antitrust Compliance Management System (CMS)
- Monitoring regulatory developments, best practices, industry trends, and compliance-related topics
- Developing and maintaining a knowledge-sharing concept for antitrust compliance, ensuring that all materials remain relevant and up to date
- Responding to external third-party audits of the ContiTech compliance program

Qualifications

- Qualification as a fully qualified lawyer (First and Second State Examination) is required
- Several years of professional experience in antitrust law and/or compliance, preferably gained in an international company, law firm, or auditing firm
- Additional experience in anti-money laundering (AML) is considered an advantage
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
- Business-fluent German and English language skills, both written and spoken; additional language skills are a plus
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills combined with a collaborative and team-oriented mindset
- Strong intercultural competence and experience working across functions and international corporate structures
- Independent, structured, and solution-oriented working style
- Willingness to travel internationally

Applications from severely handicapped people are welcome.

Additional Information

The well-being of our employees is important to us. That's why we offer exciting career prospects and support you in achieving a good work-life balance with additional benefits such as:

- Training opportunities
- Mobile and flexible working models
- Sabbaticals

and much more...

Sounds interesting for you? Click here to find out more. (https://www.continental.com/en/career/working-at-continental/benefits/)

Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging (https://www.continental.com/en/career/working-at-continental/corporate-culture-values/diversity/) are important to us and make our company strong and successful. We offer equal opportunities to everyone - regardless of age, gender, nationality, cultural background, disability, religion, ideology or sexual orientation.

jobs.occupation: Verantwortliche Elektrofachkraft Offshore-Windkraftanlagen (m/f/d) (Techniker/in - Windenergietechnik/Bachelor Professional in Technik)
jobs.description:
Imagine a future where you play a key role in ensuring electrical safety across our offshore substations and wind turbines while helping us push the boundaries of safe, efficient, and reliable offshore operations.

Join us in this role where you’ll take independent ownership of electrical safety within your area of responsibility, overseeing electrical installations on wind turbines in our German wind farms. You’ll combine your deep technical expertise with on-site presence—both at your permanent base in Norddeich and offshore—in order to guide colleagues, strengthen procedures, and ensure safe systems of work.

Welcome to HV and Transmission GER

You’ll be part of HV and Transmission GER, where you and your colleagues will ensure electrical safety governance and operational support across high-voltage infrastructure in our German offshore wind farms. Your team is dedicated to managing safety-critical systems, uplifting operational standards, and sharing expertise across the organisation.

As a team, we collaborate closely, support one another’s development, and bring a proactive, solution-oriented mindset to every challenge.

You’ll play an important role in:

- preparing and reviewing risk assessments for offshore electrical work
- supporting the selection, training, and supervision of Authorised Persons, electricians, and electrically instructed persons offshore
- contributing to the qualification and supervision of contractors in the offshore electrical environment
- developing, implementing, and improving maintenance plans for offshore electrical installations
- coordinating multiple employers involved in offshore electrical activities
- planning, organising, delivering, and documenting electrical safety training
- implementing, strengthening, and regularly reviewing the Wind Turbine Safety Rules (WTSR) and Orsted Electrical Safety Rules (OESR)
- assuming designated roles within the Safe Systems of Work, such as Authorising Engineer, Authorising Officer, or Training Mentor
- auditing work processes before offshore deployment.

To succeed in the role, you:

- have completed a degree within electrical engineering, or equivalent
- bring strong expertise within electrical safety, including standards, laws, and regulations
- demonstrate technical leadership competence
- offer switching experience in high-voltage environments above 20 kV
- communicate confidently in both English and German at B2 level or higher
- are comfortable using IT systems, including Microsoft Office, SAP, and AI tools
- ideally have a qualification for live working, experience with wind turbines, or prior responsibility as an electrician
- meet the minimum competency requirements within your onboarding timeframe, supported by our learning and development processes.

**Country-specific requirements: **fulfil the requirements of a responsible electrician (vEFK) according to VDE 1000-10.

Please note that in this role you will be mainly working in our office in Norddeich from Monday to Friday. An important part of the role will be an inspection of plants and the professional guidance of the electricians. This requires partial work offshore (20-40%) in a 7- or 14-day shift pattern.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

Shape the future with us
Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

IntroductionWe are smartmicro, the leading specialist in high-performance automotive and traffic radar- and radar/camera hybrid sensor technology. We design, develop and manufacture high-tech sensors for autonomous driving, intelligent traffic infrastructure and smart cities. Our mission is to make roads safer, enable autonomous driving in all-weather scenarios, optimize traffic flow for reduced travel times and enable greener, smarter cities.

We are a German company with international presence in the UK and in the US, while we are headquartered in Braunschweig for design, development and production.

We make the future of mobility a reality.

We are looking for an experienced Signal Processing Software Engineer.
Your Tasks

Your Strengths

What you can expect from us

About us Become a part of our innovative company and join us to develop the leading technology in the field of radar and hybrid sensors and systems.

Your missionWe are seeking a motivated Junior Fermentation Scientist to join our biotechnology team and support the development and optimization of microbial fermentation processes. This is a hands-on laboratory role with a strong focus on planning and executing fermentation experiments, from shake-flask cultivation to bench-scale fermentations.

You will work independently at the clean bench, prepare andoperate fermentation experiments, and monitor relevant process parameters and performance
indicators. Your responsibilities will also include analyzing key process and product KPIs using bioanalytical methods such as SDS-based analysis, enzymatic assays, and HPLC, as well as evaluating, documenting, and reporting experimental results.

The role offers a high degree of autonomy in organizing your day-to-day laboratory work, with responsibility for ensuring that experiments are thoroughly planned, executed, analyzed, and documented. You will contribute directly to improving our microbial fermentation workflows and advancing robust and scalable bioprocesses.
• Plan, prepare, and perform microbial cultivation and fermentation experiments, ranging from shake-flask cultures to bench-scale fermentations of up to 5 L
• Carry out laboratory work under aseptic conditions, including work at the clean bench and the preparation of culture media, buffers, solutions, and reagents
• Set up, operate, monitor, and maintain bench-top fermentation systems and associated laboratory equipment
• Monitor fermentation performance and evaluate relevant process and product KPIs throughout experimental campaigns
• Perform bioanalytical characterization of fermentation samples using methods such as SDS-based analysis, enzymatic assays, HPLC, and other relevant analytical techniques
• Evaluate experimental data, identify trends and deviations, and summarize results in a clear and structured manner
• Document experiments thoroughly and learn how to prepare concise reports of experimental results and conclusions
• Organize and prioritize your laboratory activities independently, ensuring that experiments are properly planned, executed, analyzed, and documented within agreed timelines
• Contribute to the maintenance and organization of microbial strains, cell banks, laboratory materials, and equipment
• Collaborate closely with colleagues across different disciplines and contribute to the continuous improvement of our fermentation processes and laboratory workflows

Your profile
• A degree or vocational qualification in biotechnology, microbiology, bioprocess engineering, biological laboratory technology (e.g. BTA), or a related field
• Practical experience working under aseptic conditions and confidence in standard microbiological and biotechnology laboratory techniques
• Hands-on experience with microbial cultivation; experience with shake-flask cultures and/or bench-scale fermenters is highly desirable
• Familiarity with the preparation of culture media, buffers, solutions, and reagents, as well as accurate sample handling and laboratory documentation
• Experience with, or a strong interest in learning, analytical methods for evaluating fermentation samples, such as SDS-based analysis, enzymatic assays, and HPLC
• A structured and reliable approach to experimental work, with the ability to independently organize laboratory activities and follow experiments through from preparation to data analysis and reporting
• A practical, hands-on mindset combined with curiosity, attention to detail, and a willingness to troubleshoot and learn new techniques
• A collaborative and team-oriented approach, while being comfortable taking ownership of assigned experiments and project tasks
• Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken; German is a plus

Our Benefits:

• Dynamic and diverse mission-driven team from more than 25 different countries.
• A fast growing company with exceptional opportunities for personal development.
• Flat hierarchies and short decision paths.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Ready to disrupt the food system with us?

About usInfinite Roots® is a biotech company based in Hamburg, Germany. We tackle some of the world’s biggest challenges through products we develop by leveraging the fungal kingdom. Our team of 60+ people from 25 nationalities — 55% women and 10 PhDs strong — shares one mission: to unlock the full potential of fungi for a more sustainable future.

Einleitung/Über uns

As Project Controller (m/f/d), you will support our team in project controlling, vendor management and operational controlling processes.

Your focus will be on supporting projects from a financial controlling perspective, including forecasting, reporting and monthly charging processed. In close collaboration with stakeholders across global and local controlling across market units, project teams, and external Partners, you ensure transparency and consistency in project reporting while contributing to the continuous improvement of reporting structures and controlling processes.

The role combines analytical work, operational coordination and hands-on process improvement in a dynamic finance environment.

Major Duties & Responsibilities:

- Support project controlling activities end-to-end: Prepare actuals vs. plan/forecast analyses, monitor project cost development, and support recurring project reporting and ad-hoc evaluations for ongoing projects and cost structures
- Support vendor management activities: Across the full project lifecycle, support in cost tracking, forecasting, reporting, and coordination of external partners, including the support in Statement of Work (SOW) related activities.
- Contribute to a holistic project reporting: Help align financial and project reporting in a consistent and transparent structure across projects and stakeholders (ideally with BI components)
- Perform recurring quality checks: Identify inconsistencies, coordinate corrections with relevant stakeholders and help ensure that financial structures remain accurate and up to date. This also includes the maintenance and validation of key controlling and master data, including project-related structures and financial dimensions such as cost centers, profit centers and WBS elements.
- Act as the interface between the controlling team, project team and market units: Support stable and reliable monthly charging and license allocation processes, ensuring timely and accurate execution of recurring charging activities, including validation, reconciliation and reporting of (license-related) charges.
- Contribute to the further development of reporting standards, charging concepts and controlling processes, including participation in strategic discussions around allocation methodologies and reporting structures.
- Maintain process documentation, user guidance and training materials: Ensure transparency, consistency and efficient onboarding for relevant project controlling processes.
- Support users and stakeholders in operational topics: Help resolve day-to-day issues related to reporting structures, hierarchies, project-related data and system usage.
- Support the preparation of management reports and analysis for finance and business stakeholders.
- Contribute to process improvement initiatives: Gather business requirements, structure them into clear concepts and coordinate implementation with internal stakeholders and IT where needed.
- Collaborate across functions: Work closely with colleagues in Controlling and project teams to improve data consistency, reporting reliability and the efficiency of end-to-end finance processes.

jobs.description:
Job Title:

Bioprocess Engineer – Fermentation, Process Engineering and Automation (m/f/d)

Team CCU Process Development

☀️About Us:

Join the COLIPI-an family as a hands-on Bioprocess Engineer and be at the forefront of scaling and commercializing novel bioprocesses to supply the world with microbial Climate Oil as an alternative to vegetable and fossil oils. COLIPI is dedicated to Fermenting Renewable Carbon For Generational Life Quality, utilizing renewable carbon sources and CO2 transformation to produce valuable biomaterials and contribute to the intensifying fight against global warming.

We develop gas fermentation processes for the sustainable production of bulk and high value products. Our work focuses on advanced fermentation technologies, the development and scale-up of novel bioreactor concepts, and the automation of bioprocess systems.

To strengthen our technical team, we are looking for candidates strong in fermentation and process engineering. Experience in automation is a major plus.

This is not a purely theoretical or desk-based position. You should enjoy developing technical concepts, selecting components, building and commissioning equipment, conducting experiments, and solving problems directly at the plant.

At the same time, you should be able to translate biological requirements into robust process engineering and automation solutions.

🔬Key Responsibilities:

- Support planning, building and optimizing a novel gas fermentation platform from laboratory to pilot scale
- Hands-on work during setup of the systems
- Plan, conduct, and evaluate fermentation experiments in close collaboration with the biological development team
- Analyze biological and technical process data and derive practical measures for process improvement
- Identify and troubleshooting issues in fermentation and process control automation
- Plan and support scale-up and scale-down activities

🛠️Qualifications:

- Legal permit to work in Europe
- Master’s degree in bioprocess engineering, biochemical engineering, process engineering, biotechnology, automation engineering, or a related field
- Alternatively, a comparable technical qualification combined with extensive and demonstrably equivalent professional experience
- Several years of hands-on experience with microbial fermentation processes, bioreactor operation, and bioprocess automation
- Strong understanding of the interactions between biological processes, reactor design, and process conditions
- Experience in (bio-)process automation and control engineering
- Experience with LabVIEW, C/C++, Python, or similar programming languages is an advantage
- Familiarity with programming in LabVIEW, C related or python related languagues would be a plus
- Independent, structured, and solution-oriented approach to work
- Strong hands-on mentality and enthusiasm for both designing and physically building and operating equipment
- Good written and spoken English; German skills (B2) are an advantage

🥰We Offer:

- Direct ownership of pilot-scale systems
- Building first-of-a-kind reactors
- Working with the founding team
- Influence on technology roadmap
- Opportunity to shape engineering standards from the ground up
- Competitive salary and 28 days of paid holidays

- Be part of an international team, blending academia with passionate startup vibes

- Access a fully equipped lab, cutting-edge technology, and ample room for personal development
- Participation in advanced training programs
- Annual performance appraisal meeting with manager, in addition to more frequent feedback and growth meetings

- Enjoy the vibrant atmosphere of the 2nd biggest city and 1st ranked city to live in Germany
- Experience unique maritime charm and a blazing nightlife
- Immerse yourself in a city rich in cultural events, museums, and galleries
